setup: base=$(git rev-parse HEAD); if [ "$base" = "$(git rev-parse -q --verify refs/heads/main)" ] || [ "$base" = "$(git rev-parse -q --verify refs/remotes/origin/main)" ]; then if git fetch origin main; then git merge --ff-only origin/main && echo "Worktree fast-forwarded to latest origin/main"; else echo "Could not fetch origin/main; keeping $base"; fi; fi
